100:0.en: 「Give me your all, $$フル・フロンタル$$!」

100:763.en: 「The $$赤い彗星$$ name is no mere boast!」

100:827.en: 「$$ユニオン$$ and $$ＡＥＵ$$ aces, side by side!」

100:909.en: 「I could fly wing to wing with you!」

100:1008.en: 「You shame the name of the $$ＡＥＵ$$'s ace!」

100:1205.en: 「If you'll excuse me, I'll go ahead!」

100:1280.en: 「$$グラハム・エーカー$$ is here!」

100:1313.en: 「I never knew unmasking felt so good.」

100:1386.en: 「But you mustn't be afraid of that.」

100:1419.en: 「Nice flying, $$アルト$$. Our sky is grand.」

100:1519.en: 「Ha ha ha ha ha! My romantic reply.」

100:1582.en: 「I'm a Virgo romantic. Shall I go on?」

100:1651.en: 「To settle up with a past\nof repeated folly...!」

100:1706.en: 「A life I once threw away.\nI won't waste it...!」

100:1759.en: 「I'll show a battle worthy of\nthe $$ソルブレイヴス$$ name...!」

100:1810.en: 「I'll just live so that someday\nI can stand tall before him...!」

100:1863.en: 「I know my way around a sword!」

100:1950.en: 「Is he worthy of the name\n$$赤い彗星$$? I'll find out!」

100:2007.en: 「Woman or not, a warrior...!\nHesitation would be fatal!」

100:2144.en: 「I'll never bow to an evil god!」

100:2179.en: 「Having found light in the dark,\nI fear nothing!」

100:2298.en: 「$$スフィア・リアクター$$...!\nNow, a fair and square fight!」

100:2347.en: 「The power of the evil $$スフィア$$,\nI'll seal it myself!」

100:2396.en: 「$$皇帝アウストラリス$$,\nI'll send you to your end!」

100:2445.en: 「We both bear the shame of living...!\nThen let's fight fair!」

100:2500.en: 「Even if you're emissaries of God,\nyou're still my enemies!」

100:2565.en: 「I won't serve an evil god! Prepare!」

100:2604.en: 「You were not chosen!\nYou are merely being used!」

100:2661.en: 「Those who can't decide how to live\nare no enemy of mine!」

100:2722.en: 「$$グラハム・エーカー$$ shall be\nthe guide to the future!」

100:2789.en: 「Humanity carves out its future!\nBy overcoming you, false god!」

100:3029.en: 「Behold the power of my $$ブレイヴ$$!」

100:3070.en: 「$$グラハム・エーカー$$ and\nBrave face you!」

100:3290.en: 「Pursuit is easy for the $$ブレイヴ$$!」

100:3323.en: 「Contact with the target\nmust be avoided, it seems...!」

100:3411.en: 「No mere fight! We avenge the dead!」

100:3471.en: 「The situation is hopeless, but\nI'll die before I let you pass!」

100:3893.en: 「$$グラハム・エーカー$$ lives\nto make tomorrow!」

100:4232.en: 「I won't rest until I've struck back!」

100:4354.en: 「You saved me the search. My thanks!」

100:4469.en: 「The rest?\nLeave it to $$グラハム・エーカー$$!」

100:4607.en: 「Young man, leave the rest to me!」

100:4677.en: 「$$パトリック・マネキン$$...\nskilled, but...」

100:4777.en: 「Let me add a gleam to your freedom!」

100:5083.en: 「$$キラ・ヤマト$$'s will\nwas clear to me!」

100:5159.en: 「So it's a duel between you and me!」

100:5424.en: 「Too green to take aim at me!」

100:5545.en: 「That's not enough to take my head!」

100:5842.en: 「To think I must rely on this...!」

100:5931.en: 「You lack all it takes to defeat me!」

100:5966.en: 「You would lure\nthis $$グラハム・エーカー$$?!」

100:6081.en: 「Was my first move a bit late...?」

100:6143.en: 「Tch, I can't read the alien's moves!」

100:6307.en: 「I can't fall. I'd set a bad example!」

100:6379.en: 「I truly am a man without luck...!」

100:6499.en: 「Defending the Earth Sphere means\nI can't possibly back down...!」

100:6868.en: 「$$ハワード$$... $$ダリル$$...!\nI can't go yet!」

100:7056.en: 「To do right by those who fell,\nI can't go down!」

100:7121.en: 「It isn't over yet!\nI was told to fight to live...!」

100:7251.en: 「Well done, Gundam!\nI'm $$グラハム・エーカー$$!」

100:7403.en: 「$$グラハム・エーカー$$ leads you to the future!」
